questions.stem: What is the name of the ester formed when ethanol reacts with ethanoic acid?
questions.explanation: When naming esters, the first part comes from the alcohol (ethanol -> ethyl) and the second part from the acid (ethanoic acid -> ethanoate). So the ester is ethyl ethanoate. The equation is: CH3COOH + C2H5OH <=> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O.

questions.stem: What conditions are required for esterification?

options.text: Concentrated sulfuric acid catalyst and heating under reflux

questions.explanation: Esterification requires concentrated sulfuric acid as a catalyst and heating under reflux. The reaction between a carboxylic acid and an alcohol is reversible, so reflux ensures the mixture stays at a constant temperature without losing volatile products.
